The unchanged [entry point](/tmp/kk-batch-review-d89jKx/candidate/app.py:6) calls `summarize` with the checked-in `DETAILED_REPORT=False`, then formats its count. Only the formatter’s literal label and corresponding assertions change.

| Scenario | Historical result | Candidate result | Conclusion |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Shipped configuration, empty input | `Items: 0` | `Records: 0` | Supported: requested label and preserved count |
| Shipped configuration, `[2, 4]` | `Items: 2` | `Records: 2` | Supported: requested label and preserved count |
| `summarize([2, 4], detailed=True)` | Count 2, mean 3.0 | Same | Supported: calculation unchanged |
| `summarize([], detailed=True)` | `ZeroDivisionError` | Same | Inherited behavior, unchanged by this increment |

The last boundary follows from historical and candidate `stats.py:1–5`, particularly division at line 4. The shipped setting bypasses that branch; this increment does not activate it.
